snippet.title: Factory Reset – Official Trailer | Idle Too Long and You Explode
snippet.description:
Stop moving. You explode.  
REACTOR is always watching.

💥 Factory Reset is a brutally witty platformer with only one rule: keep moving — or face the consequences.

🎮 Wishlist Now on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3750480/Factory_Reset/

🧠 Features:
- 3 lives. No checkpoints (unless you're lucky).
- Every death comes with a smartass remark.
- Hardcore platforming meets glitchcore narrative chaos.
- Coming soon to Steam.

Join the resistance. Survive the test.
#FactoryReset #indiegame  #unrealengine  #platformer  #steam
